title: $\ell$FEM: An efficient loop-free Matlab implementation of isoparametric bulk and surface finite elements
summary: The $\ell$FEM MATLAB package provides a simple, efficient, and flexible implementation of isoparametric finite elements in bulk domains and on surfaces. The finite element matrix assemblies are based on MATLAB's paged operators and therefore completely loop-free. We give a short and conscious description of high-order isoparametric surface finite elements, which is then used to describe the assembly process and the implementation.
